Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct level shift (anomaly) starting around x = 460. The data fluctuates between approximately -10 and +5 mm before this point, and then jumps to fluctuate between approximately +15 and +30 mm after this point, continuing until the end of the series.

Therefore, the range of anomalies is:
[[460, 730]]
